is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 3, Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports the L1014F kdr mutation (page 3, Results).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper provides genotype counts for the L1014F mutation: homozygote mutation 64.5% (20/31), heterozygote mutation 29% (9/31), and wild-type allele 6.5% (2/31) (page 3, Results).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from larval breeding habitats in Akim Oda, Ghana (page 2, Larval and Water Collection).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Akim Oda, Birim Central Municipal, Eastern Region, Ghana (page 1, Study Area).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The larval survey was conducted between July and October 2016 (page 1, Abstract).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, localized larval survey in Akim Oda in 2016.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide contamination in larval breeding habitats in Akim Oda, Ghana, and assessed the pyrethroid susceptibility and kdr mutation frequency (L1014F) in the resulting adult Anopheles coluzzii and An. gambiae populations.
